description: Send a preset to the led-notify daemon. Silent and a no-op when the daemon is not running. Falls back from python3 to python for Windows.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/led.py" send thinking 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/led.py" send thinking 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/led.py" send done 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/led.py" send done 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/led.py" send attention 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/led.py" send attention 2>/dev/null || true
